title: Ritesh Agarwal invests in Emori; Rise Legal, DSK Legal act on Shark Tank deal
description: Ritesh Agarwal, founder and group chief executive officer of PRISM (Parent of OYO) and an active early-stage investor, was among the sharks that invested in Emori (Arja Technologies Private Limited), a lab-grown diamond jewellery brand, on Season 5 of Shark Tank India. Rise Legal advised and represented the family office of Ritesh Agarwal on the deal.The transaction was led by Ritika Ganju (Managing Partner), with the support of Mohana Dasyam (Senior Associate), Milind Sharma (Associate) an
